resources.string: Enter a valid session API key.
Microphone access is required. Tap Record to ask again, or open app settings.
Could not record audio. Check microphone access and record again for at least a second.
Connection failed or timed out. Retry or delete this recording.
API key rejected. Check the key and project access, then retry.
API limit or balance reached. Check your API account before retrying.
API request failed. Check model availability or retry later.
No usable text returned. Retry or record again.

Recording uploads after Stop using gpt-transcribe. Live streams while the microphone is on using gpt-live-transcribe. Both may incur API charges; check current pricing, model access and billing. No automatic reconnect or retries.

Save stores your key encrypted with Android Keystore; Forget removes it. Without Save the key stays in memory. Drafts are temporary. Leaving or rotating stops the microphone/network. Live cancellation keeps received text and discards unsent audio. Copy shares only the transcript with the system clipboard.
Microphone off · waiting for final segments
Live connection interrupted. Received text is kept. Tap Record to reconnect; audio is not replayed automatically.
Recording stopped safely. Processing the full captured audio.
The saved key is unchanged. Save to replace it.
Could not read or update secure key storage. Forget the saved key and enter it again.

Optional special access. Android Accessibility lets this app observe keyboard windows and focused editor metadata across apps, and insert your final dictation. The system grants broader screen-content access; this app does not capture screenshots or read, send, log or save unrelated app text. Only audio you explicitly start is sent to OpenAI and may incur API charges. The bubble never sends messages or presses Enter. Password, numeric/payment and recognized sensitive editors are excluded. Auto-insertion requires Android 13+, a stable caret and a compatible editor; otherwise Copy is offered. No replacement keyboard or separate draw-over-apps permission is required. You can disable this feature here or in Accessibility settings at any time. Save your API key in the main app first.
Floating dictation enabled. Tap the circle to start dictation; it never starts by itself.
Floating dictation is off or Accessibility access is missing.
Allow notifications so recording always has a visible Stop/Cancel notification.
Back to API key and in-app dictation
Editor or caret changed. Recording cancelled; Copy received text yourself.
Microphone and visible recording notification permissions are required. Open setup, then tap the circle again.
Android blocked the microphone service. Open setup or use in-app dictation. No recording started.
Save an API key in the main app first. No audio or API request started.
Session failed. Microphone stopped; received text can be copied. Start again explicitly to reconnect.
Cancelled. Nothing inserted; received text can be copied.
This editor, selection or Android version cannot be inserted into safely. Nothing inserted. Copy and paste yourself.
Insertion could not be confirmed. Check the field before using Copy; it may already contain the text. No retry or Send was performed.
System clipboard could not accept the text. Nothing was submitted.
Optional Accessibility access shows a movable dictation button beside your keyboard. Read and accept the access explanation before enabling. Recording starts only when you tap the circle.
Recording uploads after Stop. Live streams while recording. Both require a valid API key. The floating button uses the same selected mode.
Add your API key in Settings
Tap to begin. Tap again to stop.
Tap to stop · Hold for controls

Tap the wave to start or stop. Hold during recording for Cancel. A red wave indicates a failed session; tap to start again. Hold while idle to open setup and recover genuinely unsent text. An unverified insertion settles silently and is never repeated. Recovery stays only in process memory until discarded or the process ends.
